case_title: DERICK BALL VS. STRUCTURE PROPERTIES, INC

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JUN-12-2023 - CONTINUED FOR PROOF OF SERVICE TO SEP-11-2023 AT 3:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF DERICK BALL IS NOT PRESENT, TEA BALL (DAUGHTER AND CO-SIGNER OF LEASE) APPEARED ON BEHALF OF DERICK BALL IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT STRUCTURE PROPERTIES IS NOT PRESENT. COURT DEEMED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON MAY-15-2023 IS NOT VALID. PROOF OF SERVICE SHOWS CLAIM WAS SERVED TO STRUCTURE PROPERTIES, INC. AT ADDRESS "2108 N STREET, STE C, SACRAMENTO, CA 95816" WHICH IS NOT THE PROPER AGENT ADDRESS FOR SERVICE. THE AGENT FOR SERVICE IS LISTED AS "1505 CORPORATION CALIFORNIA CORPORATE AGENT SERVICES, INC." ON THE SECRETARY OF STATE WEBSITE. PLAINTIFF NEEDS TO RE-SERVE CLAIM TO THE CORRECT AGENT FOR SERVICE FOR DEFENDANT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. VISITING JUDGE: SYLVIA L. HUSING; CLERK: D. AU. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
